# Evolv Technology to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


October 07, 2026 8:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_0af74e988c62c2af55f4c6dc233ea29d/evolvtechnology/news/2026-10-07_Evolv_Technology_to_Participate_in_Upcoming_294.pdf)


WALTHAM, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Evolv Technologies Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: EVLV), a leading security technology company pioneering AI-based solutions designed to help create safer experiences, today announced that its management team is scheduled to participate in the following upcoming investor conferences.


- BMO Technology Conference on Thursday, November 12, 2026, in New York City.


- Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, in New York City.


- UBS Global Technology Conference on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, in Scottsdale, Arizona.


- Northland Growth Conference on Wednesday, December 16, 2026, held virtually.


Members of the Company’s management team will be available to meet with investors during these conferences. Interested investors should contact their representative at the host firm to schedule a meeting.


**About Evolv Technology** Evolv (NASDAQ: EVLV) is designed to transform human security by helping organizations detect potential threats, mitigate risk, and enhance safety using AI-powered security solutions with robust insights. Our technology has helped to create efficient and positive security screening experiences for the world's most iconic venues and companies as well as schools, hospitals, and public spaces. Evolv's mission is to create a safer world to live, work, learn, and play. Evolv's advanced systems have scanned more than 4.5 billion people since 2019. Evolv Express® and Evolv eXpedite™ have been awarded the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) SAFETY Act Designation as a Qualified Anti-Terrorism Technology (QATT). Evolv and its products have been awarded numerous awards which can be viewed on our Certifications and Awards web page. Evolv®, Evolv Express®, Evolv Insights®, and Evolv eXpedite™ are registered trademarks or trademarks of Evolv Technologies, Inc. in the United States and other jurisdictions. For more information, visit evolv.com.
